$comment: Each entry in `screens` is one screenshot the user navigates to in the app
before running `pnpm filter=mobile screenshots:capture`. The capture script
frame-screenshots.mjs composites them into store-ready images per platform.
Captions are drafted from store/PLAY_LISTING.md + store.config.json — each
highlights one of the app's six listed features. Keep them under ~70 chars
so they wrap to two lines max at the framing font size.

screens.title: Past Bar Exams
screens.caption: 1,500+ Philippine Bar questions, 1953 to 2024.
screens.navHint: Open the Bar Exams tab and land on the year/subject browser.

screens.title: Case Digests
screens.caption: Supreme Court digests with provenance to the source.
screens.navHint: Open a case digest from the library and scroll to the facts section.

screens.title: Codal Reader
screens.caption: 1987 Constitution, Rules of Court, Republic Acts.
screens.navHint: Open the Codals tab and pick the 1987 Constitution, Article III.

screens.title: AI Study Assistant
screens.caption: Grounded answers with citations — never fabricated.
screens.navHint: Open the AI chat, send a sample query, wait for the answer with citations.

screens.title: Camera Scan-to-Digest
screens.caption: Scan a printout. Get a structured digest.
screens.navHint: Open the camera scanner and frame a sample case printout.

screens.title: Offline + Sync
screens.caption: Offline codal cache. Syncs with libertasian.com on web.
screens.navHint: Open Settings → Sync to show the last-synced timestamp and offline toggle.
